method: Offline Chromium; real sources combined into an inline ES module. Not a live-site, Safari, or physical-device test.
checks: Starts in a stable pose without automatic motion
Renderer is idle when no interaction is happening
Keyboard changes target X by the documented step
Page Up changes target depth
Keyboard target converges through IK
Mouse drag moves the target in the view plane
Mouse target converges
Null-space mode locks the actual tool point
Null-space mode produces substantial joint motion
Null-space motion preserves tip position within solver tolerance
Ghosts are bounded historical solver configurations
Pause stops both kinematic and drawing loops
Posture slider changes internal configuration, not target
Manual null-space exploration holds the tip
Joint-axis overlay can be toggled
Dexterity ellipsoid can be toggled
Orbit control changes the 3D projection
Trace mode generates a moving 3D target
Trefoil is followed by the solver, with an actual tip trail
Method note opens in a dialog
Opening the method note pauses motion
Method dialog contains keyboard focus
Escape closes the method dialog
Focus is restored after closing the dialog
Animation suspends when the study leaves the viewport
Returning to the study resumes its active experiment
Manual motion preference disables autoplay
System reduced-motion preference is respected
Reduced-motion users can explore discrete postures
Reduced-motion curve scrubbing uses the real solver
No-JavaScript fallback shows a static arm schematic
Nonfunctional controls are hidden without JavaScript
Work and contact remain available without JavaScript
Emulated touch drag updates the target
Touch target is solved correctly
Touch target dragging does not scroll the page
Touch gestures outside the handle scroll normally
No JavaScript runtime errors in the suite
